walkthroughs.body_html:
AlgorithmBestWorst
Linear searchO(1)O(n)
Binary searchO(1)O(log n)
Bubble sortO(n)O(n^2)
Merge sortO(n log n)O(n log n)

• Tiny / unsorted list → linear search
  • Big sorted list → binary search
  • Small list to sort → insertion or bubble
  • Large list to sort → merge sort
Merge sort splits the work in halves and merges sorted halves — O(n log n) instead of O(n^2). For 1,000,000 items that's ~20 million ops vs 1,000,000,000,000.
